title: CFC-11 excludes uniform local renewal on A20 sigma0 26.5 in 2012-2021 under full saturation, partial-pressure mixing and 5% tracer bounds
abstract: Can the unused tracer CFC-11 reject a published explanation of A20 oxygen loss with unchanged oxygen use? We used the same GLODAPv2.2023 paired sample on sigma0 26.5 in 2012 and 2021. CFC-11 was available for every selected cast. With full source saturation, linear mixing of tracer partial pressures and 5% bounds for CFC-11, CFC-12 and SF6, five of six A20 bins reject local renewal with age-independent removal for every retained fraction. A relaxed linear program proves this result without an initial age limit or age-spectrum shape. Three bins also fail a simple CFC-11 lower bound. Every separate cruise endpoint fits three tracers at 5% with a 50-year age limit, so the failure comes from the transport link. The relaxed local gate needs 8.12% joint bounds. The fixed published oxygen-use law and half-retention model need about 13.20% CFC-11 bounds while the other tracers remain at 5%. Allowing old-water input still fits all three tracers and oxygen with an unchanged saturating law. Thus rejection of local renewal does not establish increased respiration. Source and measurement assumptions matter: an imposed 4.98% rise in final CFC-11 makes all bins pass the 50-year tracer-only gate. The regional near-surface CFC-11/CFC-12 saturation ratio also changed. These samples do not measure the formation-region state. Two sparse occupations, shared tracer errors and the partial-pressure approximation limit causal use. Code, aggregate results, source hashes, spectra audits and dual checks are included. External records stay outside the publication.

display.caption: Three tracers test transport before oxygen use is assessed. Left: the smallest relative tracer bound for each model. Separate endpoints use a 50-year age limit. The relaxed local gate has no initial age limit. Right: unchanged oxygen-use laws still fit when old water can enter. Lines join tested laws; they do not identify a true law or ventilation share.

Regional near-surface apparent saturation ratios. Points are medians across stations; bars show interquartile ranges. The A20 CFC-11/CFC-12 ratio fell in 2021. These local samples do not measure the source state of sigma0 26.5 water and do not justify a data correction.

citations.reason: We adapt its coupled-spectrum code and test its fixed renewal example against unused CFC-11. Under the same full-saturation and partial-pressure assumptions, the third tracer rejects local uniform renewal at 5% bounds. Its two-tracer result remains valid.
We retain its sample rules and common oxygen-use laws. Three tracers still permit an unchanged saturating law when old input is allowed.
Source of preparation code and the history-knot reduction for shape-free tracer bounds.
The perfect-model age bias motivates a direct conservative-tracer test.
Earlier three-tracer TTD and oxygen-use work; our result is a test of the published A20 renewal example.
